# CW: Pharmaceuticals - Shrimp Farming

**Methods**

Aquaculture antibiotic pressure = pond area × **antibiotic_kg_ha_year** from Lyle-Fritch et al. 2006's Table 6 (kg/tonne of feed, treatment days, % farms) and semi-intensive feed demand from Table 1 (1680 kg feed/ha per crop), scaled by 1.67 cycles/year (see `~ohi_goc_prep/CW/v2025/chemcials/pesticides/script3_estimated_shrimp_pesticide_discharge.qmd`. Formalin and disease-treatment lime is excluded because that fits within the pesticide subcomponent. See `lyle_fritch_table6_antibiotics_disinfectants.csv` for more information.

## Estimated pharmaceutical discharge

```{r setup}
library(sf)
library(utils)
library(tidyverse)

```

### Join with literature rates of antibiotics given in the GoC to shrimp ponds

#### Source

Lyle-Fritch, L. P., Romero-Beltrán, E., & Páez-Osuna, F. (2006). *Aquacultural Engineering*, 35(2), 135-146. [doi:10.1016/j.aquaeng.2005.09.006](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.aquaeng.2005.09.006)

**Data files from digitized paper:**

| File | Content from Lyle-Fritch et al. 2006 |
|------|--------------------------------------|
| `lyle_fritch_table6_antibiotics_disinfectants.csv` | Table 6: doses and frequency |
| `lyle_fritch_table1_feed_production.csv` | Table 1: FCR and production (feed demand) |
| `lyle_fritch_cycle_parameters.csv` | Cycle length and cycles per year |
| `lyle_fritch_table5_disease_totals.csv` | Table 5: disease context |

![Tables 6 and 7](lyle_table_3.png)

#### Load Table 6 and Table 1

```{r load-rates}
data_dir <- here::here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/lyle_fritch_et_al_2006_digitized_data")

table6 <- read_csv(here::here(data_dir, "lyle_fritch_table6_antibiotics_disinfectants.csv"))
table1 <- read_csv(here::here(data_dir, "lyle_fritch_table1_feed_production.csv"))
cycle_params <- read_csv(here::here(data_dir, "lyle_fritch_cycle_parameters.csv"))
```


```{r load-rates}
# isolate the parameters relevant to estimating pharmaceutical application rates to shrimp farms. use the following function!!
feed_kg_ha <- table1 %>%
  filter(culture_system == "Semi-intensive") %>%
  pull(feed_kg_ha_crop_derived)

# function for the following parameters:
get_param <- function(df, name) df %>% 
  filter(parameter == name) %>% 
  pull(value)

cycle_days <- get_param(cycle_params, "culture_cycle_days_first") # 139
cycles_yr <- get_param(cycle_params, "cycles_per_year_weighted") # 1.67

calc_ab_kg_ha_cycle <- function(frac_farms, dose_kg_per_tonne, treat_days) {
  frac_farms * dose_kg_per_tonne * (treat_days / cycle_days) * (feed_kg_ha / 1000)
}

# feed-based antibiotics (Table 6)
t6_feed <- table6 %>%
  filter(include_in_antibiotic_estimate == "yes", dose_unit == "kg/tonne feed") %>%
  mutate(
    frac_farms = pct_farms / 100,
    kg_ha_cycle = calc_ab_kg_ha_cycle(frac_farms, dose_mid, treatment_days_mid)
  )

# Unidentified antibiotic: 4 mg/kg feed for 8 days
ab_unidentified <- table6 %>%
  filter(product == "Unidentified antibiotic") %>%
  mutate(frac_farms = pct_farms / 100) %>%
  { calc_ab_kg_ha_cycle(.$frac_farms, 4, .$treatment_days_mid) }

antibiotic_kg_ha_cycle <- sum(t6_feed$kg_ha_cycle) + ab_unidentified
antibiotic_kg_ha_year <- antibiotic_kg_ha_cycle * cycles_yr

tibble(
  feed_kg_ha_crop = feed_kg_ha,
  cycle_days = cycle_days,
  cycles_per_year = cycles_yr,
  antibiotic_kg_ha_cycle = antibiotic_kg_ha_cycle,
  antibiotic_kg_ha_year = antibiotic_kg_ha_year
)

t6_feed %>%
  select(disease, product, pct_farms, dose_mid, treatment_days_mid, kg_ha_cycle = kg_ha_cycle) %>%
  mutate(kg_ha_cycle = round(kg_ha_cycle, 4))

table6 %>% filter(include_in_antibiotic_estimate == "yes")
```

### Aquaculture area per watershed

```{r aquaculture-area}
usv_aq <- st_read(
  here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/cw/v2025/pesticides/int/usv_aquaculture_goc_allyears.gpkg")
)

usv_aq_reproj <- st_transform(usv_aq, st_crs(watershed_goc))

usv_aq_watershed <- st_intersection(usv_aq_reproj, watershed_goc) %>%
  mutate(area_ha = as.numeric(st_area(.)) / 10000)

aq_area_by_watershed <- usv_aq_watershed %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(basin_id, year) %>%
  summarize(aq_area_ha = sum(area_ha, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year))
```

### Estimated antibiotic mass in kg per year

```{r estimate-antibiotics}
antibiotic_watershed <- aq_area_by_watershed %>%
  mutate(
    antibiotic_kg = aq_area_ha * antibiotic_kg_ha_year,
    rate_source = "Lyle-Fritch 2006 Table 6 + Table 1",
    survey_year = 2002L
  )
```

### Pour points and OHI regions

```{r pourpoints}
ab_by_watershed <- antibiotic_watershed %>%
  group_by(basin_id, year) %>%
  summarize(
    aq_area_ha = sum(aq_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    antibiotic_kg = sum(antibiotic_kg, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

pourpoints_ab <- pourpoints_goc %>%
  dplyr::select(basin_id) %>%
  left_join(ab_by_watershed, by = "basin_id")

inland_50 <- st_read(here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/spatial/inland_50km_buffer", "inland_50km_goc.shp"))
inland_10 <- st_read(here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/spatial/inland_10km_buffer", "inland_10km_goc.shp"))
regions_marine <- st_read(here("spatial/ohi_regions/goc_ohi_rgns.shp")) %>%
  filter(location == "marine")

marine_and_inland50 <- bind_rows(regions_marine, inland_50) %>%
  dplyr::select(rgn_id, geometry) %>%
  group_by(rgn_id) %>%
  summarize(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop")

marine_and_inland10 <- bind_rows(regions_marine, inland_10) %>%
  dplyr::select(rgn_id, geometry) %>%
  group_by(rgn_id) %>%
  summarize(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop")

pourpoints_ab_final <- pourpoints_ab %>%
  filter(!is.na(antibiotic_kg), antibiotic_kg > 0) %>%
  st_intersection(marine_and_inland50) %>%
  mutate(is_within_10km = lengths(st_within(., marine_and_inland10)) > 0) %>%
  filter(!(is_within_10km == FALSE & rgn_id == "Region_4"))

pourpoints_ab_rgnid <- st_intersection(pourpoints_ab_final, goc_ohi_rgns) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(rgn_id, year) %>%
  summarize(
    aq_area_ha = sum(aq_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    antibiotic_kg = sum(antibiotic_kg, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

pourpoints_ab_rgnid
```
